name: std::equivalence_relation

declarations.code:
template <class R, class T, class U>

concept equivalence_relation = std::relation<R, T, U>;

intro: The concept equivalence_relation<R, T, U> specifies that the relation R imposes an equivalence relation on its arguments.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
Notes
sections.text: The distinction between relation and equivalence_relation is purely semantic.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Check equivalence_relation for std::equal_to<>, int, int.

summary: The concept equivalence_relation<R, T, U> specifies that the relation R imposes an equivalence relation on its arguments.
